description: SvGridSelect in Svelte 5, a grid-in-a-dropdown single-select: the panel shows options as a compact multi-column table with a header row and a search box, so a user picks an assignee by name, email and team rather than by one label. It is built on its own panel with no embedded SvGrid, takes columns and options with a labelField for the trigger, and works standalone or as a grid cell editor.

faq.question: How do I define the columns?
faq.answer: With a columns array of { field, header, width }, the same shape the grid uses. Each option row shows those fields; labelField names the one printed in the trigger after a pick.

faq.question: What does search match?
faq.answer: Every visible column, so typing part of an email or a team name narrows the rows even though the trigger shows only the name.

faq.question: Is a full SvGrid inside the panel?
faq.answer: No. The panel is a light table renderer sized for a dropdown, which keeps it fast and free of the grid's features it does not need.
